name: no-strova
description: No Strova: planejamento e análise de treino para quem pedala e corre.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-no-strova --only firestore,storage "vitest run --root firebase"
scripts.build:homolog: npm run build:homolog -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/functions
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:prod -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/functions
scripts.deploy:hosting:homolog: npm run build:homolog -w apps/web && firebase deploy --only hosting --project homolog
scripts.deploy:hosting:prod: npm run build:prod -w apps/web && firebase deploy --only hosting --project production
